messages:
maria_cs: Heads-up — Clearwater (renewal Q4) usage down ~62% over last 7d. Procurement just said they had a call with a 'LumoAI' rep exploring alternatives. Putting this in renewal-risk queue. Need quick triage + playbook.

jonah_ae: Yikes. Any signal on which product surface dropped? embeddings / generation / ingest?

maria_cs: Generation traffic primarily. Top routes are /v1/generate and chat. Most impacted flows: order-rewrite & email-compose. Dash: https://app.redwood.internal/accounts/clearwater/usage (internal).

kevin_se: Checking logs now. Quick ask — can you paste the last 3 request ids for slow/errored calls?

maria_cs: Request ids: r-20260301-81a, r-20260301-87c, r-20260302-01b

kevin_se: Looking — latency spikes line up with a model-routing change last week. We did a micro-rollout that pinned a quantized variant; fallback triggered more often. Suggest rollback to model v2.3.4 for their web tier as a short-term mitigation.

alyssa_prod: Confirmed we rolled routing on 2026-03-01 (model routing service). Could be the cause. cc @eng-runtime for safety/impact check on rollback.

maria_cs: Proposed action plan: 1) 30m customer call with procurement + eng to surface impact and decision criteria. 2) Short-term revert routing -> v2.3.4 (if safe). 3) AE/Enablement to present competitive comparator + token-cost delta. 4) Monitor 72h and escalate to execs if no recovery. Who can own rollback and monitoring?

kevin_se: I can own rollback + realtime monitoring. Will watch metrics and post updates here. Need eng-runtime thumbs for traffic-split change.

eng-runtime-bot: @kevin_se rollback ticket created: RR-4829. Estimated start in 45m, impact window ~5m.

jonah_ae: I'll lead the customer call and prepare a commercial comparator doc (LumoAI vs Redwood: latency, cost, reliability bullets). @maya_enablement can you prepare the ROI one-pager focused on order-rewrite?

maya_enablement: On it. I'll include token-cost examples, latency numbers pre/post revert, and a short checklist for their SREs to validate.

maria_cs: Scheduling: proposed Wed 10:00 PT (meeting link: https://cal.redwood/clearwater/renewal). Can everyone confirm availability?

kevin_se: 👍

jonah_ae: ✅

maya_enablement: ✅

maria_cs: I'll log the playbook tasks in SFDC and add a renewal note. Quick note: if rollback doesn't bring usage back to >80% baseline within 72h, mark renewal-risk high and prep exec outreach. I'll post updates after the call.
